readerEvidence.summary: Astra single-pass source reading, no separate model checker. All24pages of each final PDF and all7original final JPG sheets personally read in bounded windows. The existing preliminary15-question English edition was compared using all8original questionpages, but its30-page key is not claimed read. Existing preliminary transcription used only as an editing seed and adapted against final original sources. Final12edition is substantively different and does not supersede preliminary IDs. All14actual no-snap final figure PNGs personally inspected. Source graphs/captions/formula notation and arithmetic discrepancies retained. Final Q5 JPG uses gamma for mass ratio, while primary booklet/key use n; final JPG Q6 title adds on the surface. JPGpage3 retains stale15shortproblems header although cover/instructions and tasks establish12. Source key Q1 signs and w value37.44 preserved; Q2 r0,max at perihelion and238years retained; Q3 photon-energy denominator lacks factor2 inside radical as printed; Q5 annotated graph tick labels remain anomalous in actual PyMuPDF crop, not repaired; Q6 substituted ratio repeats lambda2 denominator; Q7 flux factor2 differs from pressure expression; Q10 mixes g/b/l and prints cos(l1)=0.98,cos(l2)=0.96 plus inconsistent intermediate expression; Q11 AU/SU conversion and first-quarter arithmetic retained; Q12 marking heading incorrectly says Apparent magnitude of the Moon, key switches G to K and k1 exponent3/2 differs from preceding2/3. These are source discrepancies, not missing key passages. Source figures with embedded captions do not duplicate captions; Fig.13 b appears on nextsourcepage and is restored natively below its lens-sector figure. No computed replacement answers.
